How to measure: High point shoulder (neck seam at the shoulder line) straight down to the hem edge at CB, laid flat, pleats closed
Laid flat, snaps closed, side to side 2.5 cm below the underarm point
Laid flat, snaps closed, pleats lying shut, straight across the hem edge
Snaps closed, pleats lying shut, all the way round the hem edge (= 2 × C)
Shoulder point to shoulder point (armhole seam at the shoulder line), straight across the back
HPS straight down to the underarm point (armhole seam meets side seam)
Shoulder point along the top of the sleeve to the cuff edge, cuff included
Laid flat, 2.5 cm below the underarm point, perpendicular to the sleeve centre

Cuff seam to the cuff edge

Neck seam to the stand/collar seam at CB
Stand/collar seam to the collar edge at CB
Stand/collar seam to the collar point, along the collar end edge
Edge to edge across the finished placket (centred on CF)
HPS straight down to the centre of placket snap 1 (the stand snap is extra, centred on the stand)
Centre to centre, 5 placket snaps
HPS level straight down CB to the yoke seam
HPS straight down to the horizontal pleat seam (level front, side and back)
Pleat seam straight down to the hem edge at CF and CB (A = PS + PL)

Point of measure: First pleat fold from CF / CB
How to measure: Along the pleat seam, CF (CB) to the fold of the first knife pleat, each side
Along the pleat seam, fold to fold of neighbouring pleats (4 pleats per front half and per back half)
Fold to the inner (under) fold of one pleat, at the pleat seam; intake per pleat = 2 x PD
Fold edge-stitch, full length: pleat seam to the hem (leather holds no pressed pleat on its own)
